players.product: Power transformers and substation / transmission-and-distribution equipment, including SF6 gas-free products; Numazu transformer plant expansion to about 1.5x capacity

quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 131,142 million (up 9.2%), operating income JPY 2,792 million (up 46.3%), ordinary income JPY 3,174 million (up 82.1%), interim net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 2,026 million (down 3.2%). The company notes its sales concentrate at fiscal year end (electrical equipment for power companies and government agencies, and for municipal water purification and sewage plants), so first-half sales stay relatively low against the full year. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 6,724 million. Management states demand for heavy electrical products and systems stayed firm on expanding investment in power infrastructure and renewable energy in Japan and overseas, with new projects expected to increase; it cites temporary risks from labor shortages, construction delays, FX and tariffs, while areas such as domestic infrastructure investment and margin improvement from AI / DX demand are performing well

quarterly_data.signal: Power Infrastructure segment, first half (April - September 2025): net sales up 23.3% to JPY 43,371 million and operating income improved by JPY 1,141 million to JPY 3,725 million. In the mainly overseas substation (power T&D) business, demand stayed firm in the North American market and at the German subsidiary; the mainly domestic Power & Energy business also grew sales and income through efficient production meeting demand
